mintAuthority.summary: uUSD is minted against XTZ, tzBTC, USDt, or SIRS vault collateral on Tezos. At level 15180739, token_id 0 authorizes nine engines. The 4-of-7 keyholder multisig administers every engine; the active Youves DAO V2 is also an administrator on eight engines, while the legacy XTZ V1 engine lists only the multisig. V3 contracts enforce emergency collateral ratios rather than the higher frontend target ratios. DAO co-administration does not remove the multisig's independent authority.

controls.label: Youves minting engine / vault contracts
controls.capDescription: This address is the legacy XTZ V1 engine, documented with a 300% target and 200% emergency ratio. At level 15180739, token-authorized V3 XTZ, tzBTC, SIRS and USDt engines have emergency collateral ratios of 160%, 135%, 135% and 110% respectively; their higher frontend targets are not enforced by the contracts. The official V3 documentation also lists a different tzBTC engine with a 115% frontend target and 110% emergency ratio, but that engine is not token-authorized at this observation.
controls.evidence: At Tezos level 15180739, this legacy engine's token_contract was KT1XRPEPXbZK25r3Htzp2o1x7xdMMmfocKNW and token_id was 0. Its current administrators bigmap 7710 contained only KT1Q8yKdJaU5VcBL8JcxUT9PU99m53ubERk4. The token administrator bigmap 7705 listed this engine plus eight other uUSD engines. The three-engine summary was incomplete.

controls.evidence: At Tezos level 15181100, the USDt uUSD engine administrator map independently authorizes this DAO and the keyholder multisig. DAO storage names that same multisig as break_glass_contract; official governance documentation allows the guardian to change governance parameters without a DAO proposal. No independent protective delay or bounded mint ability is inferred; directMintAbility remains unknown.

review.evidence: At Tezos level 15180739, uUSD token administrator bigmap 7705 listed nine engines for token_id 0. All nine independently authorized the 4-of-7 keyholder multisig; eight also authorized active DAO V2 KT1T3BFEu9WSQyRuV9Fyd7SqTU4rW3ptJ3NN. The earlier assertion that the DAO was not wired as an engine administrator is superseded by these reads. DAO co-administration does not remove multisig parameter authority, and no new timelock or independent bound is established by this review. The economicCapSemantics and authorityPosture are therefore retained pending a separate full DAO control-path review. V3 engines enforce emergency collateral ratios, not the higher frontend targets. Collateral remains held in per-user on-chain vaults; there is no off-chain reserve attestation or evidenced financial-regulator supervision. Gnosis Safe-specific module and guard fields remain not-applicable to these Tezos controls.
